title: Main Weapons Bay Doors
label: SOURCED
summary: Segmented ventral bi-fold bay doors with sawtooth radar-scattering edges that seal flush with the lower fuselage.
role: Rapidly open for weapon release and close flush to preserve the aircraft's stealth mold line.
materials: Composite honeycomb sandwich panels with serrated low-observable seam edges.

specs.source: Visual vertical clearance in USAF bay-open photos
